build.method: thin overlay on official published vLLM image

base.note: The official base already carries stock DFlash/DSpark support and Model Runner V2 thinking budgets. Nothing is compiled from source; the two pure-Python patches below are copied over the installed modules.

patches.purpose: Add Cohere2MoE Eagle3 auxiliary hidden states required by North's self-contained DFlash/DSpark speculators.
Skip loading an empty/unused expert bias when the model has no bias param. North checkpoints ship an all-zero per-expert bias; released vLLM predates this fix.

not_installed.name: Speculators
not_installed.reason: Official vLLM reads speculators-format config natively; the served path does not import the external package.
